summary: The proposed patch optimizes the `.delete()` method to fetch only the primary key fields, which should address the UnicodeDecodeError encountered during the deletion process.

issues.description: The patch may not fully resolve the issue as it only addresses the symptom (UnicodeDecodeError) rather than the root cause. It assumes that fetching only primary key fields will prevent the error, but this might not be the case for all models or configurations.
The patch introduces a comment that could be improved for clarity and consistency with the rest of the codebase.
